title: Causes Of Inflation
definition: Inflation is the sustained increase in the general price level of goods and services in an economy over a period, fundamentally driven by structural imbalances between aggregate demand and aggregate supply, monetary expansion, and cost structures.
importanceInUpsc: Crucial core concept frequently tested in UPSC Prelims (distinguishing demand-pull vs cost-push, monetary policy instruments) and Mains GS-3 (Mobilization of Resources, Growth, Development, and Inflation management).
learningOutcomes: Master foundational concepts and mechanisms of Causes Of Inflation.
Evaluate spatial distribution, institutional frameworks, and policy dimensions.
Apply high-yield mnemonics to solve tricky Prelims and Mains questions.
prerequisites: Core foundational concepts of National Income and Macroeconomics
